title.ja: 部分ピボットLU・Choleskyと反復改良
title.en: Pivoted LU, Cholesky and iterative refinement

assumptions.ja: SPD12、低ランク近特異8、Hilbert5、Wilkinson12を固定。binary32因子・三角解法とbinary64残差・補正の5回です。
assumptions.en: Fixed SPD matrix of size 12, a nearly singular rank-one matrix of size 8, Hilbert matrix of size 5 and Wilkinson matrix of size 12. Factors and triangular corrections use binary32; residuals use binary64, with five updates.

algorithm.ja: 手書き部分ピボットLU・下三角Cholesky・前後代入。
algorithm.en: Original implementations of LU with partial pivoting, lower Cholesky factorization and triangular substitution.

validation.ja: 実binary64入力をFraction有理数で厳密に解き、別のLAPACK DGESV/DPOSVへ照合。条件数・前進誤差・後退誤差を分離。 保存する有理数参照ベクトルは、厳密Fraction解の各成分をbinary64へ丸めたものです。
validation.en: Exact-rational solutions for the actual binary64 inputs and separate LAPACK DGESV/DPOSV comparisons. Conditioning, forward error and backward error are reported separately. Each saved reference component is the exact Fraction solution rounded to binary64.

limits.ja: 小さい固定例のみ。一般の高条件数系で混合精度の収束は保証しません。
limits.en: Small fixed examples only; convergence of mixed-precision refinement is not guaranteed for arbitrary matrices.

references.title: LAPACK Users Guide: Linear Equations
references.review_scope: Selected LU/Cholesky, CON/RFS and same-precision refinement paragraphs were read. This example uses binary32 factors and binary64 residuals; a full LAPACK source audit is not claimed.

caption.ja: 保存した12×12 SPD行列。反復改良の固定例に使います。 別の全図に示す誤差は厳密有理数解をbinary64へ丸めた参照との差です。対数表示だけ、厳密なゼロ誤差をfloat64.tinyに置いて表示します。
caption.en: The saved 12 x 12 SPD matrix used in the refinement examples. In the companion full figure, errors are measured against the exact-rational solution rounded to binary64; exact zeros are shown at float64.tiny for logarithmic display only.

summary.ja: 独立の厳密有理数解と比較し、条件数・前進誤差・後退誤差・ピボット増大を分けます。
summary.en: Exact-rational comparisons separate conditioning, forward and backward error, and pivot growth.

title.ja: 対称不定値鞍点系とSchur前処理
title.en: Symmetric saddle systems and Schur preconditioning

assumptions.ja: 速度12/24、圧力5/11の代数的混合Poisson/Stokes型ブロック。元の真の残差1e-9を共通基準にします。
assumptions.en: Algebraic mixed-Poisson/Stokes-type blocks with velocity sizes 12 and 24 and pressure sizes 5 and 11. The common original-system residual tolerance is 1e-9.

algorithm.ja: 全基底保存のLanczos最小残差LSと二重MGS GMRES。SPD合同変換で対称性を保持。 元入力の残差1e-9と固定前進上限2e-8から、行列のみのκ∞推定で内部目標min(rtol,2e-8/κ∞)を導出。独立解を停止に使わない。
algorithm.en: Stored-basis Lanczos least squares provides the educational MINRES variant; GMRES uses two-pass modified Gram-Schmidt. An SPD congruence preserves symmetry. The internal target is min(configured rtol, fixed forward-error limit / kappa_infinity), using only the matrix. The independent solution is not a stopping input.

validation.ja: LAPACK全系解、理想Schurの3点スペクトル、CGの明示的負曲率対照。
validation.en: Global LAPACK solutions, the analytic ideal-Schur spectrum and an explicit negative-curvature control for CG.

limits.ja: 理想Schurは教育用の稠密制御であり、実Stokes PDEやスケーラブルな近似前処理の完成ではありません。
limits.en: A dense, ideal-Schur educational control, not a complete Stokes PDE solver or a scalable approximate preconditioner.

references.review_scope: Selected discussion of symmetric indefinite systems, SPD preconditioners and the original residual was read. The original 1975 paper was not read. This stored-basis Lanczos least-squares variant is not a copy of the production short recurrence.

caption.ja: 速度サイズ24の固定例で使う、保存した35×35鞍点行列。
caption.en: The saved 35 x 35 saddle matrix for velocity size 24.

summary.ja: 同じ元残差の基準でMINRESとGMRESを比較し、理想Schurの三点スペクトルを検査します。
summary.en: MINRES and GMRES use the same original-system residual criterion and are checked against the ideal Schur three-point spectrum.

title.ja: 明示的再始動Krylovと内部固有値
title.en: Explicitly restarted Krylov and interior eigenvalues

assumptions.en: A fixed Dirichlet Laplacian of size 31, restart lengths 8 and 16, and at most 40 cycles. Compare the untransformed problem with shifts 0 and 950.

algorithm.ja: 二重MGS Arnoldiを単一Ritzベクトルから明示的に再始動。自前LUでshift線形解を求め、元の固有残差で停止。
algorithm.en: Two-pass Arnoldi is explicitly restarted from one Ritz vector. Original LU routines perform the shifted solves, and stopping uses the original eigenproblem.

validation.ja: 既知の正弦スペクトルと独立な全行列LAPACK。shift解・Krylov作用・元残差作用を別計数。
validation.en: The known discrete sine spectrum and an independent global LAPACK comparison. Shift-solve, Krylov and original-residual actions are counted separately.

limits.ja: 単一対称実固有対だけ。暗黙再始動・Krylov-Schur・ロッキング・一般の非正規やクラスターは未実装。
limits.en: One eigenpair of a real symmetric matrix only. No implicit restarting, Krylov-Schur, locking, or general nonnormal or clustered-spectrum capability is claimed.

title.ja: 整合質量FEM弦の一般化固有値

assumptions.ja: 単位弦・張力密度1、同次Dirichlet、内部15/31/63点、最低3固有対。
assumptions.en: A unit string with unit tension and density and homogeneous Dirichlet endpoints. Use 15, 31 and 63 interior nodes and the lowest three eigenpairs.

algorithm.ja: 要素からK,Mを組み立て、M内積のK^-1M KrylovとSciPy LOBPCGを比較。小規模な厳密K逆前処理。 LOBPCG初期列は{1,x³,x⁶}。K逆Mの次数+2像を初期spanから独立にし、{1,x,x²}の構造的階数欠落を避ける。 同じMの作用を資格済einsumのLinearOperatorで与え、dense-B adapterを通さない。固有値solver自体はSciPy LOBPCG。
algorithm.en: Elementwise K and M assembly, M-inner-product Krylov iteration on K^-1 M, and actual SciPy LOBPCG with a small exact-K-inverse preconditioner. LOBPCG starts from {1, x^3, x^6}; degree-plus-two images avoid the structural rank defect of {1, x, x^2}. The same M is applied through a qualified einsum LinearOperator, avoiding the dense-B adapter. The eigensolver itself remains SciPy LOBPCG.

validation.ja: 一般化dense eigh、独立離散スペクトル、連続体(jπ)^2への細分化。M直交性と元残差は別量。
validation.en: Generalized dense eigh, an independent discrete spectrum and refinement toward (j*pi)^2. M-orthogonality and original residuals are distinct quantities.

limits.ja: 小規模1D弦のみ。SciPyが返す前の例外では入力を保存し、未返却の内部反復を保存したとはしません。 成分資格35判定は4科学例の合格を代用せず、元SciPy内部の未返却反復は保存済みとしません。
limits.en: A small 1D string only. If SciPy raises before returning, inputs are retained; unreturned internal iterates are not claimed to be saved. The 35 component checks do not replace the four full scientific cases.
